# Tonmoy Infrastructure and Vision (TIV)

> Independent technology organization engineering sovereign developer platforms, verifiable execution runtimes, and distributed infrastructure architecture.

Tonmoy Infrastructure and Vision (TIV) is a private technology organization operating from Jayapura, Papua, Indonesia. Founded by Eshan Roy (@eshanized), TIV designs, builds, and maintains sovereign software systems, pre-trained AI checkpoints, and physical computing infrastructure.

## Founder & Leadership
- [Leadership & Engineering Stewardship](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/about/leadership/): Eshan Roy (@eshanized) — Founder, Systems Architect, and Open Source Maintainer.
- [Company Identity & Verification](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/about/company/): Official identity, physical office details, and application reference Reg-2026-346380 (Foreign Company Registration).

## Stable Software Systems (Production Releases)
- [OpenMail](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/projects/openmail/): Self-hosted, single-binary email infrastructure with native SMTP, IMAP, automated TLS, and local data ownership.
- [Mercura](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/projects/mercura/): Local-first code intelligence, repository hosting, and Mercurial forge written in Go.
- [M31A](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/projects/m31a/): High-assurance Rust autonomous software-engineering runtime with 11-stage non-bypassable policy gates.
- [Octate](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/projects/octate/): Terminal-native AI code review CLI with Tree-sitter WASM AST intelligence, LLM reasoning DAGs, and SARIF export.

## Experimental AI Checkpoints & Research
- [M31Genesis](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/projects/m31genesis/): 425M-parameter causal language model pre-trained on code and reasoning tokens.
- [M31Tesla](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/projects/m31tesla/): 228.9M-parameter autonomous agent runtime model with grouped-query attention.
- [M31Entropy](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/projects/m31entropy/): 314M-parameter architecture exploration model testing high vocabulary representation density.
- [Research Whitepaper](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/research/whitepaper/): Sovereign Internet Architecture and verifiable engineering systems.

## Sovereign Physical Infrastructure
- [Data Centers](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/infrastructure/data-centers/): Primary sovereign facility in Jayapura, Papua, Indonesia (Pusat Bisnis Jayapura, Jl. Pasifik Permai).
- [Optical & Networking](https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org/infrastructure/optical/): Authoritative DNS, sovereign routing, and private network interconnects.
